newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U says ahead of R&D schedule.
newsitem.headline: P&U says ahead of R&D schedule.

text.p: The tempo of research in Swedish-U.S. drug company Pharmacia & Upjohn was higher than expected in 1996, head of the company's Swedish operations said on Wednesday.

"During the year 11 new potential drugs have come into the development phase. This is more than we had expected and people must remember that this was during a 'merger year'," Goran Ando told Reuters in an interview.
The company has meanwhile ended around 20 projects.
P&U has said that its goal was that 15 new products a year should enter development phase. The company also said 17 new drugs would be launched between the time of the merger and the end of 1998.
"We are on time with everything. We will probably have more than 17," Ando said.
